-- NULL
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.CURRENCY = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CUSTOMERID) FROM TRANSACTIONS_1K AS T1 INNER JOIN CUSTOMERS AS T2 ON T1.CUSTOMERID = T2.CUSTOMERID WHERE T1.DATE = '2012-08-25';
